Shou keeps application caches and development projects tidy on macOS.

- Review application and browser caches, developer downloads, and project build products.
- Explore storage with a treemap and directory list; save personal cleanup rules.
- Move selected items to Trash, restore from History, or separately confirm permanent removal.
- Native settings in the sidebar, English and Simplified Chinese interfaces, and light/dark appearance.
- Built-in online updates with signed archives and a signed update feed.
- Independent CLI with interactive cleanup confirmation.

Requires macOS 14 or later. The universal app and CLI support Apple Silicon and Intel.

Download the DMG and drag Shou.app to Applications. The ZIP contains the same app; the CLI archive runs independently. SHA256SUMS verifies download integrity.

This release is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple-notarized. If macOS blocks the initial launch, verify the download source and review System Settings → Privacy & Security. App updates are independently verified with Sparkle's Ed25519 signatures.

简体中文：原生 Mac 清理工具，支持应用缓存、开发工具与项目清理、空间分析、个人规则、清理历史与恢复、独立 CLI，以及经过签名验证的在线升级。下载 DMG 后将 Shou.app 拖入应用程序目录。支持 macOS 14+、Apple Silicon 与 Intel。此版本为 ad-hoc 签名，尚未经过 Apple 公证。
